reason: No Christoffel appears among the Viljoen owners. The candidates are Fredrik Jacobus, Jan Hendrik (an estate), Willem, Hermanus David Jac and Willem Jacobus, all clearly different given names.
The single candidate, David Stephanus Fourie of Beaufort, matches the given names and the declared district exactly.
Martinus van der Merwe of Somerset is the only Marthinus/Martinus candidate, and his district agrees with the declared Somerset. Nothing contradicts the match, since the genealogy gives no father.
Pieter Hendrik de Necker of Swellendam matches Pieter Hendrikus and the district. The other De Neckers are recorded as sons of Piet/Pieter, which fits them being his sons.
No Cornelis Hermanus Zacharias Booysen is listed. The only candidates are Jacobus and Jan Hendrik in Graaff-Reinet, not Somerset.
Lourens jr's father was Lourens sr. C02 Lourens Petrus is recorded as son of Petrus, which contradicts this, and C05 Lourens sr is the father, not the son.
Petrus Paulus Steyn of Swellendam matches both given names and the district exactly.
His father was Stephanus Johannes, but C01 Gert is recorded as son of Gert, a contradiction. C07 Gert Hendrik has a different second name, and no candidate matches Gert Stephanus Jacobus.
No Johannes Jacobus Janse van Rensburg is listed. All candidates carry different first names and are in Uitenhage or Albany rather than Somerset.
Petrus Johannes Erasmus of Somerset matches the name (Pieter/Petrus) and the district. His note 'sv PJ' agrees with the genealogy father, Pieter Johannes.
